name: plan_update
description: Update the status of one step in the active plan created by `plan`: mark a step `running` before starting it and `done` when finished; use `failed`/`skipped` when a step cannot be completed as planned. Each call echoes the full updated plan text with per-step status suffixes and an overall progress summary. The plan state is persisted per session; re-calling `plan` with the same steps keeps existing step statuses.

step.description: 1-based step number to update, as listed by the active plan.

note.description: Optional short note (e.g. failure reason or skip rationale); echoed in the step status, e.g. `(failed, note: ...)`.
